name: Son Goku
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)The Four-Tails, a giant monkey with octopus tails and exceptional physical prowess. It creates and controls fire and earth together for volcanic eruptions and lava. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
